# Juicefall

> Juicefall is a falling-jelly puzzle game for iPhone where you match colors, not rows. Coming to the App Store in November 2026. Free to play, with ads between games, no subscription and no account; one purchase, the full game, removes the ads. It plays offline. Made by Aaron Seaman. On the App Store as "Juicefall: Jelly Match Puzzle".

How it plays: jelly shapes drop into a narrow well; the player slides and turns them. Three or more jellies of one color in a row or a column burst, and whatever falls after a match can match again, so one drop can set off a chain whose every step multiplies the points. Full rows do nothing. Landings and clears fill a swap meter that banks up to three swaps; when a shape lands, glowing jellies show every swap that makes a match. The shape of a match makes a fruit power-up (free: a blueberry that clears its row, a banana that knocks jellies off the board; with the full game also an orange that clears its column, a strawberry that bursts a 3 by 3 area and grapes that clear a whole color, plus the pineapple, dragon fruit and kiwi). Two fruit of a kind swapped together make a super fruit, three times as strong; with the full game, two different fruit fuse into a kiwi with both powers. Modes: Wild (speeds up every level), Calm (no gravity: shapes fall only when dropped), Hectic (levels up twice as fast, with freeze diamonds), and Quirky Play, a 90-second game with a new quirk each day, the same for everyone.

Key facts:

- Release: November 2026
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26 or later
- Price: free, with ads; one in-app purchase, the full game (US$2.99 in the United States), removes the ads and adds six fruit power-ups; Family Sharing included
- Ads: Google AdMob, a full-screen ad between games (at most once every few minutes) and a banner after a game, limited to general-audience content; the full game removes them. Subscription: none. Account: none
- Privacy: the game itself sends nothing to the developer; without the full game, Google's ad software collects data for the ads and to see how the game performs, with consent where the law requires it, and the game asks once for tracking permission (App Tracking Transparency)
- Internet: not needed
- Game Center: three leaderboards (Wild, Calm, Hectic) and 27 achievements; records sync through the player's iCloud
- Accessibility: every color a shape of its own; VoiceOver actions
- Languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish
- Age rating: 4+
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823235878 (live from release day)
